verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims "SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync" as enterprise features, and a community user separately confirms SAML/SCIM support while noting some of it is enterprise-only. However, no SCIM plugin documentation is in the pack, so its depth is unverified. Missing for 10: dedicated SCIM docs/endpoints, evidence of group sync, evidence that IdP deprovisioning revokes sessions/access, clarity on enterprise-tier gating, hands-on corroboration.
